ways.label: Mount Somers Track, Sharplin Falls car park to Woolshed Creek car park

start.name: Sharplin Falls car park
start.quote: Sharplin Falls car park is at the end of Flynns Road, Staveley.

via.name: Morgan Stream
via.quote: Follow the markers across Morgan Stream and Woolshed Creek to Woolshed Creek Hut.

evidence: Mount Somers Track runs from the Sharplin Falls car park to the Woolshed Creek car park along the northern side of Mount Somers.
The track is a two-day tramp suitable for families.

via.name: Mount Somers Summit Track junction
via.quote: the junction of the Mount Somers Summit Track

evidence: You can combine Mount Somers Track with the Bus Stop Track and South Face Track to make a circuit. This circuit starts and ends at Sharplin Falls car park.
For the circuit, follow Mount Somers Track to Woolshed Creek Hut, as described above. Then take the alternative route described below to loop back to Sharplin Falls car park.

ways.label: Overnight return from Woolshed Creek car park to Woolshed Creek Hut
evidence: You can also do an overnight return tramp on the track, either from Woolshed Creek car park to Woolshed Creek Hut (an easier option) or from Sharplin Falls car park to Pinnacles Hut (a much more challenging option).

ways.label: Overnight return from Sharplin Falls car park to Pinnacles Hut

start.name: Sharplin Falls car park
start.quote: Sharplin Falls car park is at the end of Flynns Road, Staveley.

evidence: You can also do an overnight return tramp on the track, either from Woolshed Creek car park to Woolshed Creek Hut (an easier option) or from Sharplin Falls car park to Pinnacles Hut (a much more challenging option).
The track climbs steeply through mountain beech forest/tawhairauriki to Dukes Knob before following Bowyers Stream to Pinnacles Hut.

ways.label: Alternative exit: Woolshed Creek Hut to Woolshed Creek car park via Bus Stop and South Face Tracks
evidence: This is an alternative route for the last day of the Mount Somers Track. It is more challenging than Mount Somers Track.

From Woolshed Creek Hut, the track climbs some 500 metres to a local feature known as the Bus Stop Overhang. From here, the track crosses the face of Mount Somers to link with South Face Track (2 hr from the track start), which then follows a rocky ridge to Woolshed Creek car park.
